1.summary_text: Mrs. Bennet learns that wealthy bachelor Mr. Bingley has rented nearby Netherfield Park. She urges her husband to visit him so their five daughters might meet him.

2.summary_text: Mr. Bennet surprises his family by revealing he already visited Bingley. The Bennet sisters meet Bingley at a local ball, where he shows interest in Jane.

3.summary_text: Bingley’s friend Mr. Darcy snubs Elizabeth at the ball, calling her tolerable but not handsome enough to tempt him. Elizabeth overhears and forms a dislike of Darcy.
